# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Completed the DIC/photosynthesis remediation by finalizing the shipped `medium_planted` regression path: the day/night probe now samples complete settled cycles from the last 72 hours so end-of-dark/end-of-light counts stay aligned, `moderate_planted` water was retuned to a lower alkalinity profile to keep the scenario inside the tightened 6.0-8.0 pH envelope, and the `medium_planted` startup default photoperiod was increased to 12h so the real scenario now clears the required >=0.1 pH separation. The resulting suite passes with the planted lights-off regression and tightened photosynthesis stoichiometry checks active.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the existing photosynthesis/DIC regression coverage and confirm how the shipped `medium_planted` scenario behaves under the stronger acceptance criteria.
2. [Completed] Harden the regression expectations so the planted scenario probe samples complete settled light/dark cycles instead of mismatched boundary counts.
3. [Completed] Retune the shipped `moderate_planted` source-water alkalinity and the `medium_planted` startup photoperiod so the actual scenario shows a >=0.1 pH day/night split while staying within the tighter pH envelope.
4. [Completed] Run focused validation across the DIC regression suite and adjacent scenario/budget integration coverage.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test photosynthesis_dic` passed (9 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` passed (24 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration` passed (13 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_data` passed (32 tests).

## Outstanding Risks

- I did not run the full workspace test matrix; validation was focused on the DIC/photosynthesis path plus adjacent scenario and carbon-budget regressions.
